status.description:
`awaiting_upload` until the file arrives, `processing` while it is validated, then
`completed` (every row created) or `rejected` (nothing created, file quarantined).

upload.description:
Pre-signed S3 `POST` target. Send `multipart/form-data` to `url` with every entry of `fields`
as a form field (verbatim, order preserved), then the CSV as the last part named `file`.
Files larger than `max_bytes` or with another content type are refused by S3 itself.

row_count.description: Data rows found in the file (null until processed)

created_count.description: Todos created (equals row_count when completed, 0 when rejected)

errors.description: First contract violations when rejected (the full report is quarantined with the file)

items.description: One contract violation. `row` is the 1-based data row (0 = the file itself).
